en.headline: Mastercard payments briefly disrupted worldwide after system update
en.dek: Hong Kong users reported declined transactions and Apple Pay failures on Saturday afternoon before the company confirmed systems had returned to normal.
body: Mastercard experienced a global disruption to card payments on Saturday after a scheduled system update caused transactions to be declined for a period of time.

In Hong Kong, users reported problems with physical cards, Apple Pay and cash withdrawals. Similar reports emerged from Australia, Japan, Singapore, the United Kingdom and other markets. Downdetector recorded a sharp spike in outage reports in Australia during the afternoon.
A Mastercard spokesperson said a scheduled system update had caused transactions to be declined earlier in the day. The situation had been resolved and all systems were working normally again.

Hong Kong Information Technology Federation honorary president Charles Mok attributed the incident to a technical anomaly during a routine upgrade that temporarily disrupted global transaction data transmission. He noted that while core payment networks have high redundancy standards, large cross-border upgrades still carry residual risk.

zh.headline: 萬事達卡全球系統更新故障 香港用戶交易一度被拒
zh.dek: 周六下午包括香港在內多地用戶反映刷卡、Apple Pay及提款受阻，公司其後確認系統已恢復正常。
body: 萬事達卡（Mastercard）周六因預定系統更新，一度令全球多地交易被拒，包括香港用戶在實體卡、Apple Pay及現金提款等場景均受影響。
澳洲、日本、新加坡及英國等地亦有類似報告。澳洲故障監測網站曾錄得近兩千宗相關報告。
萬事達卡向傳媒表示，一次預定系統更新導致交易在較早時段被拒絕，目前情況已經解決，所有系統正正常運作。
香港資訊科技商會榮譽會長方保僑指，事故主因源於例行系統升級過程中的技術異常，引發全球交易數據傳輸暫時癱瘓。他指出核心支付網絡雖有極高備援標準，但大型跨國升級仍存在不可預期的技術風險。
